title: docs(qa): checklist items for the zero-citation packages since 18.3.0, and the coverage.json close-out of the 18.4 sweep
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8toRgaedgsgjb43pGUwdE8)_ Fixes #32270 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：18.3.0 以来改动过、却没有任何清单项引用的 28 个包，逐个有了结论：新增 6 个清单项（推送设备登记与托管中继启动、控制台手机号登录的两步验证、退出登录与服务器端失效的会话、报表下钻只列度量算到的记录、测试短信按调用者语言回答、种子数据按组织语言挑选），其余 22 个包在 `coverage.json` 写明为什么不需要清单项；同时把专题 #32022 的八个主题逐项映射到清单项，阻塞项（含 M2 留下的六个多副本项）和计划项都写明原因。按席位审核意见，把前提已落地的计划项 `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address`（客户端 SDK 按包寻址）转为 active：步骤读自 #32197 落地的代码，并在真实 showcase 启动上跑通全部条款后才转正；顺带更正 `api-backend.automation-namespace-address` 里两行过时的 SDK 说法。 - 为什么改：18.4.0 发版候选的 QA 运行按 `since:v18.4` 挑项。没有这次收口，这些包的用户可见行为不在任何一项里，各主题的阻塞原因也只散落在三个里程碑 PR 中。 - 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` 下的清单数据与跟进记录，不动产品代码；新加的 `releaseSweeps` 键没有任何门禁读取；回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`（`releaseSweeps.v18.4` 的主题映射与 28 个包的结论）、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json`（两个控制台登录项，P1）、`areas/api-backend.json` 中转正的 `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address`、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` §19。 - 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs && node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json`，预期校验 OK、挑出 54 项（加 `--include-blocked` 为 65 项）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## Zero-citation packages: before 28, after 22 The scan maps `git diff --name-status 83d7e4ae 60b99f8f` to the 92 workspace packages it touches and checks each against the paths in every active or draft item's `source[]`, reading the legacy spelling `objectui packages/X` as `ui/packages/X`. Read strictly, the counts are 41 before and 35 after. The 13 packages cited only under the legacy spelling are listed in `releaseSweeps.v18.4.legacySpelling`. | Package | Disposition | |:--|:--| | `packages/services/service-push` | new item `integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot` | | `ui/packages/mobile` | new item `integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot` (the shell half, pins only) | | `ui/packages/auth` | new items `identity-auth.console-two-factor-prompt-phone-doors`, `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` | | `ui/packages/plugin-report` | new item `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` | | `packages/services/service-sms` | new item `i18n.sms-test-answer-language` | | `packages/plugins/organizations` | new item `i18n.seed-dataset-follows-organization-language` (blocked: fixture) | | `examples/app-crm` | covered through `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`, `records-forms.field-history-tracking`, `studio-authoring.dataset-member-vocabulary`, `ai.mcp-dataset-tools` | | `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb` | covered through `platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade` | | `packages/services/service-print` | covered through `access-security.credential-use-audit-row` | | `ui/packages/plugin-charts` | covered through `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope`, `dashboards.chart-type-matrix` | | `ui/packages/plugin-designer` | covered through `studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip` | | `ui/packages/plugin-view` | covered through `records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore` | | `examples/app-multi-package` | internal-only: namespace rename of metadata names | | `packages/adapters/hono` | internal-only: forwards the request to `getPublicConfig`; the open tree supplies no organization editions | | `packages/apps/connector-docusign`, `connector-stripe` | internal-only: the listing file, the `template_manifest` kind this map waives | | `packages/apps/connector-github` | internal-only: the listing file plus pinned MCP tools; needs a GitHub credential no fixture holds | | `packages/drivers/driver-turso` | internal-only: the remote face only; the boot migration lock is an M2 replica fix with no new surface | | `packages/qa/scenarios` | internal-only: QA tooling, not a platform surface | | `packages/services/service-package` | internal-only: the store answers the row it wrote | | `packages/services/service-queue` | internal-only: lease reclaim and the dispatch loop's wake time | | `ui/packages/cli` | internal-only: eight known schema type names | | `ui/packages/plugin-editor`, `plugin-markdown`, `runner` | internal-only: a retired alias leaves `vite.config.ts` | | `examples/app-todo`, `packages/qa/http-conformance`, `ui/examples/schema-catalog` | test-only | Each row's full reason, with the PRs it reads, is in `coverage.json` under `releaseSweeps.v18.4.packages`. ## coverage.json changes - `metadataKinds`: `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` is mapped to `dataset` and `report`, and the promoted `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address` to `action`, `flow` and `page` (the kinds its run drives, as its three sibling address items are mapped). The other new items drive no governed metadata kind, and the blocked one carries none. - New top-level `releaseSweeps.v18.4`, read by no gate (`check-platform-checklist.mjs` and `checklist-select.mjs` read `metadataKinds` only): - `themes`: the eight themes of #32022 and M4, each with its items. Every blocked item says why, and the six theme-2 multi-replica items M2 left unmapped are mapped here. They still carry no metadata kind, as §17 ruled for an item no run can drive. Every planned item says why. - `packages`: the 28 dispositions above. - `legacySpelling`: the 13 packages cited only as `objectui packages/X`. | Theme | Covered (runnable) | Blocked | Planned | |:--|--:|--:|--:| | 1 · package namespaces (M1) | 17 | 0 | 0 | | 2 · multi-replica on Redis (M2) | 2 | 6 | 0 | | 3 · AI service accounts and identity (M1) | 8 | 0 | 0 | | 4 · recycle bin (M2) | 4 | 0 | 0 | | 5 · multi-currency amounts (M2) | 4 | 0 | 1 | | 6 · action preflight and page bindings (M3) | 4 | 0 | 1 | | 7 · AI data tools and MCP (M3) | 5 | 1 | 0 | | 8 · federation and CLI (M3) | 5 | 3 | 0 | | M4 · zero-citation packages | 5 | 1 | 0 | | **Total** | **54** | **11** | **2** | ## Final `since:v18.4` counts, for the QA seat's release-candidate run - `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json`: **54** items (48 before this PR: the six new items' five runnable ones, plus the promoted one). - `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --include-blocked --json`: **65** items (58 before). ## What changes - Six new items, all `since: "v18.4"`, revision 1, history ref #32270, read from source at `60b99f8f`: - `integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot` (P2, mixed): device registration under the session with its origin, the 400 refusals for a web device with no vendor and a non-canonical origin, the owner-only 404 delete, the relay boot and its unbound warning, the air-gapped boot refusal and the unrequested push key warning. - `identity-auth.console-two-factor-prompt-phone-doors` (P1, browser): phone + password and the phone code each reach the two-factor step on an enrolled account. - `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` (P1, browser): sign-out sweeps both browser stores to the device keys and drops the return link; a session revoked on the server sends the next in-app navigation to sign-in with its path kept. - `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` (P2, mixed): the dataset answer's `drillScopes` per measure, none for a derived one, and the report drawer and Open in list both carrying the scope. - `i18n.sms-test-answer-language` (P2, api): `sms/test` answers in the language of Accept-Language, else `?locale`; zh-TW reads Traditional, and an unknown language reads English. - `i18n.seed-dataset-follows-organization-language` (P2, api, `blocked(fixture)`): the founder's language, else the app default, picks the locale-scoped seed dataset. - **Promoted, after a passing live run:** `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address` (P2, api), planned → active at revision 2, `since: "v18.4"`. #32197 landed the SDK's namespace option and #32272 put the candidates on the `/meta` 409. Steps and clauses are read from `packages/client` at `60b99f8f`: the bare path is unchanged without a namespace; a namespace sends the qualified path and reaches that namespace's holder; `execute` and `trigger` build the addressed run doors; a 409 reaches the caller with `details.candidates`; `invoke` resolves `success: false` with no candidates on a 404; and a namespace or name the router would misread is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` before any request. - **Corrected:** `api-backend.automation-namespace-address` revision 2. A variant line and the route-ledger `source[]` line said every addressed `/automation` row is server-only because the SDK names no namespace. Since #32197, eleven are `disposition: 'sdk'`. No step or clause changes. - `coverage.json` as above. - `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §19: scope and method, before and after, the promotion and its run, the correction, eleven M1 items whose scratch package ids (`com.qa.addr_a`, …) `objectstack build` refuses, package changes no item covers, one comment drift, and the fixtures that would lift the blocked item. ## Tests Docs and checklist data only; no product code, so no unit tests. The checklist validator, the selector, the derived gates and the promoted item's live run are under Verification. ## Acceptance notes - Ask 1, zero-citation packages: every package on the before list has an item or a recorded reason (`releaseSweeps.v18.4.packages`). Each new item's clauses are read from the code at `60b99f8f`: routes, refusal texts and log lines quote the source, and anchors resolve through `symbol-anchors.mjs`. No live run was made. - Ask 2, the close-out: every `since:v18.4` item appears in exactly one theme. Every blocked and planned item says why, including the six multi-replica items. A scratch cross-check found 0 mismatches against the area files: each listed item exists, the blocked ones carry `blocked`, the planned ones are `planned`, and each new item's `source[]` cites its package. - Ask 3: the counts above. - The promotion re-authors an M1 item. The seat asked for it in review: a planned item whose premise has landed is the order's stale-`source[]` case. README "Implementation status" makes promotion earned, so it carries a live run (below). Per RUNNER's verification re-run rule, its evidence is this body and the item's history row, and no `qa-run` issue is filed. - Recorded, not edited: eleven M1 items name scratch package ids with an underscore, which `objectstack build` refuses (FOLLOW-UPS §19b). A runner substitutes the hyphen (`com.qa.addr-a`). - Not touched: `areas/automation.json` (a sibling card's file). ## Verification Read on the committed head `fb5f36884` (two commits on `60b99f8f`). - `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0. "OK — 16 areas, 427 items (419 active, 3 planned); coverage: 40 kinds mapped, 4 waived". Symbol anchors 1570/1580 resolved: the 10 unresolved are the standing #16898 residual, the same 10 as before this diff, so every new anchor resolves. - `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json`: exit 0, 54 items. With `--include-blocked`: exit 0, 65 items. - The zero-citation scan, before and after: 28 → 22 packages (41 → 35 strict). - Scratch cross-check of `releaseSweeps.v18.4` against the area files (on `97c6ab294`): every `since:v18.4` item and every planned item mapped exactly once; 0 errors. On `fb5f36884` the promoted item moves from theme 1's `planned` to its `items`. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on `fb5f36884`: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Changed lines 1,044, under the 3,000 threshold. - `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --body` on this body: the one closing declaration is the line for this card.
The 16 derived gates and their exit codes ``` node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs :: exit 0 node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test :: exit 0 pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions :: exit 0 pnpm check:ci-filter-parity :: exit 0 pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs :: exit 0 pnpm check:doc-authoring :: exit 0 pnpm check:driver-memory-census :: exit 0 pnpm check:gitlink-declared :: exit 0 pnpm check:nul-bytes :: exit 0 pnpm check:platform-checklist :: exit 0 pnpm check:refd-timer-probe :: exit 0 pnpm check:watch-hint-literal :: exit 0 ``` The first run in a fresh worktree had six of these exit 3 (prerequisite: no `node_modules`). After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and a `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint` build under the verify lock, all 16 were run on `97c6ab294`, and again on `fb5f36884` after a full `pnpm build`, with the codes above both times.
The live run of api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address (revision 2): every clause passed Boot: `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 4517` on this worktree at `97c6ab294` (`60b99f8f` plus checklist data only), after a full `pnpm build` (119 tasks). Fixture: `qa_a` (`com.qa.addr-a`, pages `qa_home` and `qa_only_a`) and `qa_b` (`com.qa.addr-b`, page `qa_home`), built with `objectstack build` and installed with `os package install`. As admin, the environment page `qa_env_home` and the environment flow `qa_env_flow`. Client: `packages/client/dist/index.mjs`, constructed with a `fetch` that records each request, signed in with `client.auth.login`. | Call | Sent | Answer | |:--|:--|:--| | `meta.getItem('page','qa_home',{namespace:'qa_a'})` | `GET /api/v1/meta/page/qa_a/qa_home` | qa_a's page; byte-identical to `?package=com.qa.addr-a` | | `meta.getItem(…,{namespace:'qa_b'})` | `GET /api/v1/meta/page/qa_b/qa_home` | qa_b's page | | `meta.getItem('page','qa_home')`, and with `{namespace: undefined}` | `GET /api/v1/meta/page/qa_home` (both) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, candidates `com.qa.addr-a`, `com.qa.addr-b` | | `meta.getItem('page','qa_env_home',{namespace:'_env'})` | `GET /api/v1/meta/page/_env/qa_env_home` | the environment page | | `meta.getItem('page','qa_only_a',{namespace:'qa_b'})` | `GET /api/v1/meta/page/qa_b/qa_only_a` | 409, candidates `com.qa.addr-a` | | `meta.getItem('page','history',{namespace:'qa_a'})`, and under `'Crm'` | nothing | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, "The request was not sent" | | `meta.getItem(…,{namespace:'qa_a',packageId:'com.qa.addr-b'})` | `GET …/qa_a/qa_home?package=com.qa.addr-b` | the door's 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | | `automation.get('showcase_batch_reminders')`, and with `{namespace: undefined}` | `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase_batch_reminders` | the flow | | `automation.get(…,{namespace:'showcase'})` | `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders` | the bare body, byte for byte | | `automation.get(…,{namespace:'qa_b'})` and `automation.trigger(…,{namespace:'qa_b'})` | `GET …/qa_b/…` and `POST …/trigger/qa_b/…` | 409, candidates `com.example.showcase`; no run added | | `automation.execute(…,{params:{tasks:[]}},{namespace:'showcase'})` | `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders/trigger` | `success: true` | | `automation.trigger(…,{params:{tasks:[]}},{namespace:'showcase'})` | `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders` | `success: true` | | `runs.list` bare, then under `showcase`, then bare | `GET …[/showcase]/showcase_batch_reminders/runs?limit=50` | 6 ids, then 8 (the two runs above), then the same 8 | | `runs.get(…, newest, {namespace:'showcase'})` | `GET …/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders/runs/RUN_ID` | that run, `completed` | | `automation.get('qa_env_flow',{namespace:'_env'})` | `GET /api/v1/automation/_env/qa_env_flow` | the environment flow | | `automation.get('runs',{namespace:'showcase'})`, and a flow under `'trigger'` | nothing | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | | `automation.get('runs',{namespace:'_env'})` | `GET /api/v1/automation/_env/runs` | the door's 404 "Flow not found" | | `actions.invokeGlobal('showcase_portfolio_snapshot')`, and under `showcase` | `POST /api/v1/actions[/showcase]/global/showcase_portfolio_snapshot` | the same `{ success: true, data: { ok: true, scope: 'global', … } }` | | `invokeGlobal` under `qa_b`, and under `_env` | `POST …/qa_b/global/…`, `POST …/_env/global/…` | `success: false`, "… not found on object 'global' in namespace 'qa_b'" / "… in the environment"; no `candidates` key | | `actions.invoke(…,{namespace:'global'})`, and under `'Bad'` | nothing | `success: false` with the refusal text | 26 requests in all; the six refused calls sent none. One correction made during the run: a run of `showcase_batch_reminders` with an empty body answers 400 `FLOW_FAILED` ("Unknown variable: tasks") after the door reaches the flow, so the item sends `{ params: { tasks: [] } }`, and a negative line says so.
No other live checklist run was made: that is the QA seat's `since:v18.4` run on the release candidate. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzg5cGA5sp7x8mF9aNr
